description: offset is the documented alias of skip.

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name SKIP 2 LIMIT 50 $$) AS ("name" agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.name)) LIMIT 50 OFFSET 2

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.name)) LIMIT 50 OFFSET 2
